expo._comment_single_listing: RoadMate Rider is ONE Play Store listing, unlike apps/business's four. A shop's own delivery boy and a RoadMate delivery partner install the same app — the delivery flow is identical and only the money differs (HANDOFF §3, §4). So there is no app.config.js here and no APP_VARIANT: this file is the whole configuration.
expo.name: RoadMate Rider

plugins._comment: The wording a rider actually reads at the permission prompt. It has to say what the location is FOR — it is not analytics, it is what decides whether they are offered a job at all.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: RoadMate Rider uses your location while you are on shift so orders near you can be assigned to you, and so the customer can see you coming.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: RoadMate Rider uses your location while you are on shift so orders near you can be assigned to you, and so the customer can see you coming.

plugins._comment: Proof of delivery (2026-08-09). The prompt says what the photo is for and that it is optional, because it is — the delivery code is what completes an order, and a refused camera must never make one undeliverable.
plugins.photosPermission: RoadMate Rider can attach a photo to a delivery as proof it was handed over. This is optional.
plugins.cameraPermission: RoadMate Rider uses the camera to photograph a completed delivery as proof it was handed over. This is optional.

extra._comment_apiUrl: Overridden per environment. A phone cannot reach the API on localhost — this must be the dev machine's LAN address (see .env.example).

expo._comment_icons: TODO(design): RoadMate Rider needs its own icon and store screenshots. It currently ships apps/business's placeholder art. Same accent (#DEBE10), different mark. Assets only, no code.
